log.msg: linkage-test 404 investigated: could not reproduce in 6 fresh headless contexts (with/without trailing slash on ?run=) — h1="Vision browse", 90 rows, 0 errors every time. Structurally ruled out ?run= as cause: Router.js:38 go() and App.js:63 load() both pass location.pathname only into load_segments, query string never reached. Most likely a live-reload race while files were still being edited, or a stale VS Code tab. No change made to vision/page.js or browse.js; Router/App.js untouched (core files, and not implicated).

follow-up: findings now render fix (muted 2nd line), decl as a code chip (sel { decl }) + ladder_rung as a tiny tag, retracted struck through; turn2.cost_usd appended to the tokens line. All conditional — missing keys render nothing, old runs unchanged. Proved on vision-fixes (18 rows, 6 decl chips, 6 rungs, 74 fix lines, turn2 cost shown, 0 errors); shot: vision-fixes-decl.png. div.sidebar region picks: no special-case added, per instruction.

query-string SPA nav fixed. Root cause (browse.js/page.js only, no Router edit): (a) run-listing links were plain <a href=?run=...> — same-pathname click never re-diffs in core/Router.js activate() (~L130, from===to chain, nothing to (de)activate) so content() never reran despite pushState landing; (b) filters already bypassed Router (select onchange -> replaceState+redraw), confirmed working, untouched; (c) cross-page pill click: Router.js go() (~L44) calls history.pushState AFTER activate()->content() runs, so a fresh landing reads stale location.search. Fix: browse() now owns url state itself (an open()/navigate() closure, no arg from page.js), run-links intercept click+pushState+redraw directly (nav_link()), plus a setTimeout(0) post-mount recheck for the cross-page race and a popstate listener for back/forward. Proved with real clicks (not goto): (a) rows 0->24 switching to vision-fixes via a real .click(), url updates [click-a-run-link.png]; (b) prompt select rows 90->77, url shows &prompt=; (c) dispatched click on the actual task-card pill, rows 0->90, url updates [click-c-pill.png]. 0 console errors all three.
